text:
Mina: Quick sync — I'm drafting the telemetry ingest contract for the new per-org dashboards. Need runtime signals and infra inputs hooked up. Thinking we need: model_variant, tenant_id (hashed), request_qps, tokens_in/tokens_out, p50/p95 latency, gpu_id, queue_depth, and backend_error_count. Any privacy or perf constraints?
Alex: Sounds right. Two asks from infra: 1) keep payload small (no more than ~1KB/event) and 2) don't send raw tenant IDs — hash with per-cluster salt. We also need batchable records.
Samir: For noisy-neighbor detection we also want short-window metrics (1m token rate, 1m tail latency) vs baseline. Could we include `sample_rate` meta so runtime can pick 1% full-detail sampling + 100% aggregate counters?
Mina: Yes — propose schema: `event_type`, `org_hash`, `model_family`, `seq_len`, `tokens_out`, `tokens_in`, `latency_ms_p50`, `latency_ms_p95`, `qps`, `error_count`, `gpu_uuid`, `queue_depth`, `sample_rate`. Keep everything numeric or small enums.
Chen: +1 for sample_rate. For privacy: ensure org_hash is irreversible and salted per-region. Also retention policy: 90d for detailed samples, 13mo for rollup aggregates.
Lia: Console / UX note — per-org dashboards must be tenant-isolated: customers can only see their `org_hash` view, and internal users can opt into `customer_impersonation` mode for support. Need RBAC flags: `view_customer_dash` and `impersonate_customer`.
Alex: Implementation detail: runtime will emit two streams — `rollup` (1s/10s aggregates) and `sampled` (1% payloads). Rollup keeps P50/95 and counts. Sampled has full request traces (id, prompt_len, model_variant). We'll compress/avro them.
Samir: Noisy neighbor algorithm proposal: for each org, compute recent z-score for tokens_per_gpu_min and p95_latency_min vs org_baseline (30d sliding window). Alert if z > 4 for 3 consecutive mins OR if sustained p95 delta > 30% for 10m. Also maintain watchlist with TTLs (manual and auto-add via severity).
Mina: That aligns with product. Also need signal to route failing requests to fallback model variants when noisy neighbor detected. Routing team: this will be a runtime policy hook keyed by `org_hash` -> route to `variant_fallback` if noisy flag true.
Chen: Another constraint: for Dedicated customers with privacy requirements, we must support sending telemetry to customer VPC only (no central ingestion). Add a `destination` header: `central` or `customer_vpc`.
Lia: UX: rollout should default to opt-in for customers to see per-org telemetry. In Console, admins get a toggle: "Enable per-org telemetry (rollup only)" and a separate opt-in for sharing sampled traces for support.
Samir: Need clarity on quotas: telemetry ingress shouldn't count against customer inference quotas. But we do want to meter telemetry egress when sending to external systems. Product ok with that?
Mina: Product agrees — telemetry ingestion is platform-internal and free. Export to third-party sinks will be billed separately.
Alex: Security note: deploy-bot will create an encryption key per-telemetry-stream. Use KMS + HSM for customer_vpc streams. Also verify that hashed org id + model_variant cannot be re-identified by combining with other metrics.
deploy-bot: [deploy] telemetry-schema-v2 branch created: github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/221. CI lint passed.
Chen: Perf question: will adding GPU UUID in events increase cardinality explosion for dashboards? We should limit GPU dimension to `gpu_type` + `cluster_zone` instead of UUID for aggregated UI. Keep UUID only in sampled traces.
Mina: Good call — change: rollups include `gpu_type` and `cluster_zone`; sampled traces include `gpu_uuid`.
Lia: For the Console row-level security: implement server-side filter in metrics API that accepts `viewer_role` + `org_hash` and enforces `org_hash` match. Also audit logs for any impersonation sessions.
Samir: Ops/Oncall: define runbook for noisy-neighbor alerts. Quick sketch: 1) validate metric spike, 2) check for correlated model_variant spikes, 3) temporarily throttle or route to cheaper variant, 4) contact customer or internal account owner.
Mina: Action items: 1) Alex to finalize schema PR (#221) by EOD + add cluster salt note. 2) Chen to update retention/aggregation knobs in pipeline config. 3) Lia to prototype Console toggle + RBAC frames. 4) Samir to draft noisy-neighbor runbook doc. I'll own end-to-end spec.
Alex: I'll post PR link when ready. Also will add example payload in PR:
```
{ "event_type":"rollup", "org_hash":"sha256:abcd...", "model_family":"gptx-13b", "qps":12.4, "latency_ms_p50":42, "latency_ms_p95":120, "tokens_out":3200, "sample_rate":0.01 }
```
Chen: I'll sync with infra about `customer_vpc` egress path and KMS keys.
Lia: I'll mock the Console toggle in Figma and share.
Samir: I'll wire the z-score job into watchtower and share thresholds.
Mina: Thanks — let's reconvene after PR review. :thumbsup:
